connector.name: Openfinance Br MCP
connector.registryDescription: Secure Open Finance Brasil MCP server with typed tools and a credential-free mock mode
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package openfinance-br-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the brunovicco account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ENVIRONMENT
env.description: 'mock' (default, no credentials needed - runs entirely in-memory), 'sandbox', or 'production'

env.name: CLIENT_ID
env.description: Client ID registered with the participating institution. Required unless ENVIRONMENT=mock

env.name: PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
env.description: Path to the RSA private key used for private_key_jwt and JAR signing outside mock mode

env.name: PRIVATE_KEY_KID
env.description: Key ID matching the registered client JWKS entry outside mock mode

env.name: MTLS_CERT_PATH
env.description: Path to the client mTLS certificate used outside mock mode

env.name: MTLS_KEY_PATH
env.description: Path to the client mTLS private key used outside mock mode

env.name: REDIS_URL
env.description: Optional Redis connection URL for persistent consent and token state

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Required only when calling list_transactions with categorize=true (DSPy transaction categorization)
